mapper.sql: a.id AS "id", a.company_id AS "company.id", IFNULL(company.name,'') AS "company.name", a.user_id AS "userId", a.user_login_name AS "userLoginName", a.user_name AS "userName", a.patient_id AS "patientId", a.patient_name AS "patientName", a.action AS "action", a.remarks AS "remarks", a.create_by AS "createBy", a.create_date AS "createDate", a.update_by AS "updateBy", a.update_date AS "updateDate", a.del_flag AS "delFlag"
LEFT JOIN org_company company ON company.id = a.company_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO record_access_audit( id, company_id, user_id, user_login_name, user_name, patient_id, patient_name, action, remarks, create_by, create_date, update_by, update_date, del_flag ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{company.id}, #{userId}, #{userLoginName}, #{userName}, #{patientId}, #{patientName}, #{action}, #{remarks}, #{createBy}, #{createDate}, #{updateBy}, #{updateDate}, #{delFlag} )
